changelog:
- Fokk Mesh Service Stability: Fixed Android 14 foreground service crash by removing systemExempted requirement and making startup non-blocking.
- Fokk AI In-Page Modal Fix: Completely removed intrusive DOM summary modal, routing all summarizer actions cleanly to the native bottom sheet.
- Reasoning Scratchpad Leak Fix: Stripped internal thinking tokens and chain-of-thought scratchpad notes from AI responses, delivering direct authoritative answers.
- Dynamic Truth & Bias Audit: Replaced static keyword regex templates with dynamic multi-source analysis across domain identity, rhetorical stance, and evidence density.
- Ask AI Receipts Redesign: Eliminated vertical duplicate receipt buttons, consolidating all corroborating sources into a horizontal scrolling drawer with favicons.
- Summary UX Improvements: Positioned Multi-Source Evidence Drawer at the bottom of the summary tab, reordered tabs (Summary & TTS, Ask AI, Truth & Bias Audit), and added smooth tab bar scroll collapsing.
- Fokk AI Logo Integration: Replaced plain text AI badge in the browser bottom menu with the official Fokk AI logo.
